mapper.select: SELECT symbol, ex_date, split_type, old_rate, new_rate FROM stock_splits WHERE symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY ex_date
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO stock_splits (symbol, ex_date, split_type, old_rate, new_rate, vendor_id, source, synced_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{exDate}, #{splitType}, #{oldRate}, #{newRate}, #{vendorId}, 'ALPACA', NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM holdings WHERE quantity > 0 ORDER BY symbol
